seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [player,wall,wall] show mixed outcomes: h,pixels,y x1, h,pixels,w,x,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a global object such as a counter, HUD element or legend, read as state. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:

Counter fields are invariant across all 44 transitions; selection comes from black hole pixels.
The two ACTION4 cases differ through axis position, piece occlusion, reflected components entering the board, and rank-based renaming.
Gray vertical and invisible horizontal/double reflections, layered rendering, connected components, and target bbox clustering match every field.
Stateless, 215 lines, all 44 transitions pass; unobserved clicks/reset are no-ops, fully hidden selection defaults to horizontal axis.
